li.label: thumbs up
li.description: A bionic thumb was raised in my direction. The whole hand moved, but the thumb was clearly in charge.

li.label: two thumbs up
li.description: Two bionic thumbs up! The stereo servo whir is oddly moving. Maybe the Guild is onto something.

li.label: three thumbs up
li.description: Three bionic thumbs up! I keep thinking about the engineering. Do they have a newsletter or something?

li.label: four thumbs up
li.description: Four bionic thumbs up! The neural feedback is apparently so precise they can feel me smiling back.

li.label: five thumbs up
li.description: Five bionic thumbs up! High-fives are now Predator handshakes.
